raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- Register the SM100 MegaMoE per-expert tensors that are copies of the expert parameters as parameters of the experts module: the UTCCP-transposed L1/L2 scales in `build_mega_moe_experts_weights`, and the NVFP4 `mega_l1_alphas`, `mega_l2_alphas` and `mega_l2_act_scales` in `ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoEMethod._build_mega_moe_weights`. EPLB moves each expert's slice of every routed-expert parameter (`get_moe_weights`), so a rebalance now moves these copies with the weights they come from; before, moved experts kept the previous experts' scales
- SM90 and ROCm MegaMoE already read the parameters EPLB rewrites; unchanged

No behavior change without `--enable-eplb`, except that these tensors now appear in `named_parameters()`.

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DEP2 on 2 x GB300 (`--tp 2 --dp 2 --ep-size 2 --enable-dp-attention --moe-a2a-backend megamoe`, `--eplb-rebalance-num-iterations 32` when EPLB is on), GSM8K with sgl-eval, 200 examples, greedy, thinking off:

| Code | EPLB | Rebalances | GSM8K (%) | Avg output (tokens) |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| main | on | 142 | 72.50 | 465.4 |
| this PR | on | 35 | 97.00 | 127.2 |
| this PR | off | 0 | 97.50 | 127.6 |

The main run rebalanced more often because its longer outputs kept the eval running longer.

detail.title: [Fix] megamoe: Support EPLB rebalance on SM100

files.patch:
@@ -579,6 +579,16 @@ def build_mega_moe_experts_weights(experts) -> None:
 
     experts.mega_l1_weights = (experts.w13_weight.data, w13_sf_utccp)
     experts.mega_l2_weights = (experts.w2_weight.data, w2_sf_utccp)
+    # EPLB moves each expert's slice of every parameter, so the UTCCP copies
+    # move with the scales they are transposed from.
+    experts.register_parameter(
+        "mega_w13_weight_scale_utccp",
+        torch.nn.Parameter(w13_sf_utccp, requires_grad=False),
+    )
+    experts.register_parameter(
+        "mega_w2_weight_scale_utccp",
+        torch.nn.Parameter(w2_sf_utccp, requires_grad=False),
+    )
 
     experts._mega_moe_weights_built = True

@@ -2635,9 +2635,15 @@ def _build_mega_moe_weights(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
 
         layer.mega_l1_weights = l1_pair
         layer.mega_l2_weights = l2_pair
-        layer.mega_l1_alphas = l1_alphas
-        layer.mega_l2_alphas = l2_alphas
-        layer.mega_l2_act_scales = l2_act_scales
+        # Parameters, so EPLB moves each expert's values with its weights.
+        for name, value in (
+            ("mega_l1_alphas", l1_alphas),
+            ("mega_l2_alphas", l2_alphas),
+            ("mega_l2_act_scales", l2_act_scales),
+        ):
+            layer.register_parameter(
+                name, torch.nn.Parameter(value, requires_grad=False)
+            )
         # Free the checkpoint layout.
         layer.w13_weight.data = l1_pair[0]
         layer.w13_weight_scale.data = l1_pair[1]
